_comment: Human adjudication of gradings the automated matcher could not settle. Keyed by question text. 'correct' overrides bioasq.grade(). Proposed by Claude; needs a domain check on the entries marked debatable.

Which is the most prevalent form of arrh.note: Prediction 'Atrial fibrillation' is right; the GOLD is misspelled ('atrial fibrilation'), which is why token matching failed.

Which human disease is experimental auto.note: 'Multiple sclerosis' is exactly what EAE models; gold phrases it as 'Model of MS (Multiple Sclerosis)'.

Which is the causative agent of malaria?.note: 'Plasmodium parasite' and gold 'Plasmodium species' are the same answer.

What is the function of the protein SERT.note: 'Transports serotonin' is the verb form of gold 'Serotonin transporter'.

Sclerostin regulates what process?.note: DEBATABLE. 'Bone formation' vs gold 'bone metabolism' - sclerostin inhibits bone formation, so arguably more precise than the gold.

Which ligament is most commonly injured.note: GRADER FALSE POSITIVE. Model said 'anterior cruciate ligament'; dashboard injury damages the POSTERIOR cruciate. Token overlap on 'cruciate ligament' made the matcher accept it.

What does gepotidacin do to bacteria?.note: DEBATABLE. 'Inhibits bacterial growth' is true but misses the mechanism in gold ('inhibits bacterial DNA replication'); kept wrong as too vague for a factoid.

What is the drug target for Eliquis (Api.note: Factor X and Factor Xa are different molecules (zymogen vs active enzyme). Matcher was right to reject.
